title: ID0443867-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001028]-Vehkala FW bug with screensaver.
description:
When screensaver is activated, you select socket for authentication but then press "back", UI goes directly back to screensaver and not to outlet selection.
Video in timeline
Solution:
bugfix by R&D in v9.X

additional_info.subject: Status update
additional_info.body:
Issue reported when charger was on v7.0.5.
Charger is now on v8.0.5, and issue still persists.

additional_info.subject: Status update
additional_info.body:
Discussed the topic with Markus today. The video reports the behavior with FW v7.0.5.
With fw v8.0.5, issue still persists.
On 15.08.2025, tried to remove and add screensaver from SCB, no results.
Deeper investigation required.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0443867-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001028]-Vehkala FW bug with screensaver. CRM:02699000166
additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0443867,
following our discussion from today via MS Teams.
The issue of the intrusive screensaver on charger
MP/P9 170001028
has been analyzed by R&D, and a fix has been identified. The fix will be included in
FW v9.X
, which is the successor to
v8.1.X
, currently in beta testing. There is currently no estimated release date for
v9.X
, it will be communicated by Product Champion in the upcoming weeks through PLM touchpoint meeting and via official channels.
Therefore, as agreed, I will proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you!
